page.title: Departments
page.subtitle: Organise your tenant into departments and their sections

form.createDescription: Add a department and optionally assign existing sections to it.
form.editDescription: Update the details of this department.
form.title: Title
form.imageHint: JPEG, PNG or GIF · max 2 MB
form.imageTooBig: The image may not be greater than 2 MB.
form.imageBadType: The image must be a jpeg, png, jpg or gif file.
form.sectionsHint: Selected sections are moved into this department.
form.titleTooLong: The title may not be longer than 255 characters.

delete.title: Delete department?
delete.description: “{{title}}” will be moved to the deleted list. Its sections are kept. You can restore it later.

forceDelete.title: Delete permanently?
forceDelete.description: “{{title}}” and ALL of its sections will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.

bulkDelete.title: Delete {{count}} departments?
bulkDelete.description: The selected departments will be moved to the deleted list.

bulkRestore.title: Restore {{count}} departments?
bulkRestore.description: The selected departments will become active again.

bulkForceDelete.title: Permanently delete {{count}} departments?
bulkForceDelete.description: The selected departments and ALL of their sections will be permanently removed. This cannot be undone.

notice.bulkSkipped: {{processed}} of {{total}} departments processed; the rest were skipped.
notice.notFound: That department no longer exists. The list was refreshed.
notice.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
